purpose: Shared behavioral fixtures for poc-elastic and ror-elastic. Assert matching document IDs and behavioral ordering, not exact Elasticsearch _score values.

cases.expect: documents matching either term; both-term matches should normally rank above single-term matches
phrase intent is preserved by simple_query_string
space is required; adventure is optional
matching spider documents exclude horror matches
near-match behavior where the analyzer/query syntax supports it
every result satisfies the genre filter
every result has vote_average >= 7; browse mode sorts popularity descending
title suggestions start with the provided prefix; duplicate texts are removed
accent-folding behavior is covered when the fixture corpus contains accented titles
